articles.summary: Babbel Chief Executive Officer Tim Allen Appointed to the Board USA TODAY Co., Inc. (“USA TODAY Co.”, “we”, “us”, “our”, or the “Company”) (NYSE: TDAY) today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Tim Allen, Chief Executive Officer of Babbel, to the Company’s Board of Directors. “We are pleased to announce Tim’s appointment and excited to welcome him to the Board. Tim brings an exceptional combination of leadership, digital innovation expertise, and consumer-focused growth experience,” said Michael Reed, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of USA TODAY Co. “Tim’s deep understanding of subscription and direct-to-consumer business models, and track record leveraging technology and AI to drive growth and deepen customer engagement will be invaluable as we continue expanding our digital opportunities. articles.title: USA TODAY Co. Announces Appointment of Independent Director to Board of Directors - USA TODAY Co.
